lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨੀ ਘਟੀ ਸਹੁ ਵਸੈ ਸਹ ਬਿਨੁ ਘਟੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanee ghatee sahu vasai sah bin ghat na koi ||
lines.translation: God the Cosmic Husband dwells within all hearts; without Him, there is no heart at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak te sohaaganee jinhaa guramukh paragat hoi ||19||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are the happy, virtuous soul-brides; the Lord is revealed to them. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਖੇਲਣ ਕਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau tau prem khelan kaa chaau ||
lines.translation: If you desire to play this game of love with Me,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਤਲੀ ਗਲੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sir dhar talee galee meree aau ||
lines.translation: then step onto My Path with your head in hand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੈਰੁ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: it maarag pair dhareejai ||
lines.translation: When you place your feet on this Path,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਕਾਣਿ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: sir deejai kaan na keejai ||20||
lines.translation: give Me your head, and do not pay any attention to public opinion. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਰਾੜਾ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਕੂੜੈ ਕੂੜੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naal kiraaRaa dosatee kooRai kooRee paai ||
lines.translation: False is friendship with the false and greedy. False is its foundation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਮੂਲਿਆ ਆਵੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: maran na jaapai mooliaa aavai kitai thaai ||21||
lines.translation: O Moollah, no one knows where death shall strike. ||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਹੀਣੰ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਪੂਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan heena(n) agiaan poojaa ||
lines.translation: Without spiritual wisdom, the people worship ignorance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਵਰਤਾਵਾ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dh varataavaa bhaau doojaa ||22||
lines.translation: They grope in the darkness, in the love of duality. ||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur bin giaan dharam bin dhiaan ||
lines.translation: Without the Guru, there is no spiritual wisdom; without Dharma, there is no meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਮੂਲੋ ਨ ਬਾਕੀ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: sach bin saakhee moolo na baakee ||23||
lines.translation: Without Truth, there is no credit; without capital, there is no balance. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣੂ ਘਲੈ ਉਠੀ ਚਲੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanoo ghalai uthee chalai ||
lines.translation: The mortals are sent into the world; then, they arise and depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਦੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਵੇਹੀ ਗਲੈ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: saad naahee ivehee galai ||24||
lines.translation: There is no joy in this. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਝੁਰੈ ਦਲ ਮੇਲਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਲੁ ਅਧਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam jhurai dal melavai a(n)tar bal adhikaar ||
lines.translation: Raam Chand, sad at heart, assembled his army and forces.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਸੈਨਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜੁਝੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)tar kee sainaa seveeai man tan jujh apaar ||
lines.translation: The army of monkeys was at his service; his mind and body became eager for war.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਾ ਲੈ ਗਇਆ ਦਹਸਿਰੋ ਲਛਮਣੁ ਮੂਓ ਸਰਾਪਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: seetaa lai gaiaa dahasiro lachhaman mooo saraap ||
lines.translation: Raawan captured his wife Sita, and Lachhman was cursed to die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪਿ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karataa karanahaar kar vekhai thaap uthaap ||25||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Creator Lord is the Doer of all; He watches over all, and destroys what He has created. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਝੂਰੈ ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ ਸੀਤਾ ਲਛਮਣ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mahi jhoorai raamacha(n)d seetaa lachhaman jog ||
lines.translation: In his mind, Raam Chand mourned for Sita and Lachhman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਣਵੰਤਰੁ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਆਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hanava(n)tar aaraadhiaa aaiaa kar sa(n)jog ||
lines.translation: Then, he remembered Hanuman the monkey-god, who came to him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲਾ ਦੈਤੁ ਨ ਸਮਝਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoolaa dait na samajhaee tin prabh keee kaam ||
lines.translation: The misguided demon did not understand that God is the Doer of deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸੋ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak veparavaahu so kirat na mitaee raam ||26||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the actions of the Self-existent Lord cannot be erased. ||26||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹੌਰ ਸਹਰੁ ਜਹਰੁ ਕਹਰੁ ਸਵਾ ਪਹਰੁ ॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: laahaur sahar jahar kahar savaa pahar ||27||
lines.translation: The city of Lahore suffered terrible destruction for four hours. ||27||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਹੌਰ ਸਹਰੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਦਾ ਘਰੁ ॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: laahaur sahar a(n)mrit sar siphatee daa ghar ||28||
lines.translation: The city of Lahore is a pool of ambrosial nectar, the home of praise. ||28||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦੋਸਾਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਨੀਸਾਨੀ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅੰਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: udosaahai kiaa neesaanee tot na aavai a(n)nee ||
lines.translation: What are the signs of a prosperous person? His stores of food never run out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦੋਸੀਅ ਘਰੇ ਹੀ ਵੁਠੀ ਕੁੜਿਈਁ ਰੰਨੀ ਧੰਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: udosee ghare hee vuthee kuRiee(n) ra(n)nee dha(n)mee ||
lines.translation: Prosperity dwells in his home, with the sounds of girls and women.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤੀ ਰੰਨੀ ਘਰੇ ਸਿਆਪਾ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਕੂੜੀ ਕੰਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: satee ra(n)nee ghare siaapaa rovan kooRee ka(n)mee ||
lines.translation: All the women of his home shout and cry over useless things.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਲੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਖਟੇ ਦੰਮ ਸਹੰਮੀ ॥੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: jo levai so devai naahee khate da(n)m saha(n)mee ||29||
lines.translation: Whatever he takes, he does not give back. Seeking to earn more and more, he is troubled and uneasy. ||29||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਬਰ ਤੂੰ ਹਰੀਆਵਲਾ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਚਨ ਵੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pabar too(n) hareeaavalaa kavalaa ka(n)chan va(n)n ||
lines.translation: O lotus, your leaves were green, and your blossoms were gold.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਦੋਖੜੈ ਸੜਿਓਹਿ ਕਾਲੀ ਹੋਈਆ ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kai dokhaRai saRiohi kaalee hoeeaa dehuree naanak mai tan bha(n)g ||
lines.translation: What pain has burnt you, and made your body black? O Nanak, my body is battered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਨਾ ਲਹਾਂ ਜੈ ਸੇਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaanaa paanee naa lahaa(n) jai setee meraa sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: I have not received that water which I love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਡਿਠੈ ਤਨੁ ਪਰਫੁੜੈ ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੁ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: jit dithai tan paraphuRai chaRai chavagan va(n)n ||30||
lines.translation: Seeing it, my body blossomed forth, and I was blessed with a deep and beautiful color. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਜਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਚਲਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raj na koee jeeviaa pahuch na chaliaa koi ||
lines.translation: No one lives long enough to accomplish all he wishes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜੀਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਰਤੀ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaanee jeevai sadaa sadaa suratee hee pat hoi ||
lines.translation: Only the spiritually wise live forever; they are honored for their intuitive awareness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਫੈ ਸਰਫੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਏਵੈ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saraphai saraphai sadaa sadaa evai gaee vihaai ||
lines.translation: Bit by bit, life passes away, even though the mortal tries to hold it back.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਪੁਛਿਆ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kis no aakheeai vin puchhiaa hee lai jaai ||31||
lines.translation: O Nanak, unto whom should we complain? Death takes one's life away without anyone's consent. ||31||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਅਹੁ ਰਾਇ ਨੋ ਮਤਿ ਚਲੈ ਜਾਂ ਬੁਢਾ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dos na deahu raai no mat chalai jaa(n) budhaa hovai ||
lines.translation: Do not blame the Sovereign Lord; when someone grows old, his intellect leaves him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਲਾਂ ਕਰੇ ਘਣੇਰੀਆ ਤਾਂ ਅੰਨੑੇ ਪਵਣਾ ਖਾਤੀ ਟੋਵੈ ॥੩੨॥
lines.transliteration: galaa(n) kare ghanereeaa taa(n) a(n)nhe pavanaa khaatee tovai ||32||
lines.translation: The blind man talks and babbles, and then falls into the ditch. ||32||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਘਟਿ ਵਧਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore kaa keeaa sabh kichh pooraa ghat vadh kichh naahee ||
lines.translation: All that the Perfect Lord does is perfect; there is not too little, or too much.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਐਸਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਂਹਿ ਸਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੩੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh aisaa jaanai poore maa(n)hi samaa(n)hee ||33||
lines.translation: O Nanak, knowing this as Gurmukh, the mortal merges into the Perfect Lord God. ||33||
